operationUnit: one actual strict-boolean &&= expression and retention of expression result and final target
specification: Select all four Boolean old/RHS combinations dynamically from iteration and seed; actual logical assignment alternates skipped/executed RHS paths and retains expression result and final target as interleaved 0/1 leaves of length 2*n.
notes: Boolean tables/setup, indexing, target initialization, actual short-circuit assignment, two branch-to-0/1 conversions and complete int-array construction/retention are timed. Conversion uses the existing boolean_or pattern; no boolean-array ABI or nullable/coercion equivalence is claimed. One assignment counts as one operation despite two retained leaves. Complete observation runs outside timing. Untimed source-order evidence observes selected index once, skipped RHS and committed state.
